text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed bumps in Thomas McClintock Lane, between Ainsworth Road and Antonios Mavrakakis Lane.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in Thomas McClintock Lane, between Ainsworth Road and Antonios Mavrakakis Lane, at the locations shown on Attachment 1 to the report (March 14,2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
